report.summary: Proposed 8 items addressing documented gaps: docstring fix, exception handling, outcome policy, path safety, drift freshness, suffix matching, dedup normalization, identity anchor validation. Each item has steps, verification, and dependencies.
risks: Fixing docstring may cause confusion if consumers rely on can_write=False behavior.
Changing exception handling may break existing error recovery.
Adding drift freshness check may increase latency if drift data is expensive to regenerate.
Path safety fix may break existing workflows that rely on symlinks.
Identity anchor validation may reject existing valid data if assumptions about current state are wrong.
todos: Verify existing tests pass after each change.
Update integration tests for path safety and identity anchor.
Document assumptions about node ID uniqueness and attribute normalization.

items.title: Fix docstring in ollama.py to match can_write=True or change flag to False
items.why_now: Documentation inconsistency could mislead developers; fixing it prevents future bugs.

steps.do: Update docstring in OllamaProvider to state it is not read-only or change can_write to False if appropriate

items.assumption: No consumer relies on can_write=False; if so, change docstring only.

items.title: Restrict exception handling in _run to only catch subprocess.CalledProcessError
items.why_now: Broad except Exception masks unexpected errors like MemoryError; narrowing improves error transparency.

steps.do: Modify _run to catch only subprocess.CalledProcessError and let other exceptions propagate
steps.verified_by: Inspect _run function: ensure except Exception is replaced with except subprocess.CalledProcessError

items.assumption: No other exception types need to be caught; if so, add specific exceptions.

items.title: Add missing outcome keys to OUTCOME_POLICY in picker.py
items.why_now: Missing keys cause valid outcomes to be mapped to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME with inappropriate residual/severity.

steps.do: Add entries for OUTCOME_TASK_INVALID and OUTCOME_COULD_NOT_RUN to OUTCOME_POLICY dict

items.assumption: Appropriate residual and severity values can be determined; if not, use reasonable defaults.

items.title: Add symlink resolution to _safe_join and _refuse_primary_checkout
items.why_now: Without realpath, symlinks can escape containment, compromising path safety.

steps.do: Add os.path.realpath call in _safe_join before checking path containment
steps.verified_by: Write test creating symlink pointing outside and verify _safe_join raises error
Write test with symlink in worktree path and verify refusal

items.assumption: Worktree manager does not already prevent symlinks; if it does, this is redundant.

items.title: Add drift freshness check in picker.py before using drift data
items.why_now: Stale drift snapshots could lead to incorrect scheduling decisions.

steps.do: Add check that drift snapshot timestamp is not older than a threshold (e.g., inventory timestamp)
steps.verified_by: Write unit test verifying picker rejects stale drift data

steps.do: If drift.py check() returns timestamp, use it; otherwise add timestamp return
steps.verified_by: grep 'def check' daedalus/drift.py and check return value includes timestamp

items.depends_on: Add missing outcome keys to OUTCOME_POLICY in picker.py
items.assumption: Drift data is persisted and not regenerated each time; if regenerated, freshness check is unnecessary.

items.title: Clarify node ID uniqueness requirement or change _same_node to use full equality
items.why_now: Suffix matching can cause false positives if node IDs are not unique suffixes.

steps.do: Document that node IDs must be unique suffixes; optionally change _same_node to use exact match if practical

items.assumption: Test framework ensures unique suffixes; if not, change to exact match.

items.title: Add test for edge deduplication with None vs empty string attributes
items.why_now: Canonical key normalization may incorrectly deduplicate edges with semantically different attribute values.

steps.do: Write a test that creates two edges with attributes {'a': None} and {'a': ''} and asserts both are kept

items.assumption: Current behavior may deduplicate; if test passes (both kept), no fix needed.

items.title: Add validation for identity_anchor in EventVectorStore
items.why_now: Without enforcement, invalid or misused identity_anchor values can corrupt event data.

steps.do: Add validation in EventVectorStore that identity_anchor is one of 'missing', 'created', 'adopted' and that 'created' is only set on first write
steps.verified_by: Write unit tests that attempt to set invalid identity_anchor and expect errors

items.assumption: No existing valid data violates the constraints; if so, migration needed.
